game_chess.name: チェス
game_chess.title: チェス
game_chess.desc: 世界で最も伝統的な戦略ボードゲーム。
game_chess.rules: White 手数 first. Move pieces one at a 時間 to checkmate the 相手's king. A king で no legal 手数 while in check is checkmate — game over.
game_chess.special1: When neither king nor rook has moved と no pieces stand between them, move the king two squares toward the rook (O-O / O-O-O).
game_chess.special2: After your pawn reaches the 5th ランキング, it may capture an enemy pawn that just moved two squares beside it.
game_chess.special3: A pawn reaching the last ランキング automatically promotes to a queen.
game_chess.coach_desc: Click a piece to highlight すべて legal 手数; after each move, AI gives a bilingual ヒント to ヘルプ you understand the position.

game_tictactoe.name: 三目並べ
game_tictactoe.title: 三目並べ
game_tictactoe.desc: 3×3 grid. Connect three in a row to 勝利.
game_tictactoe.rules: 3×3 board, you are ✕ と move first. Players take turns placing marks; the first to line up three in a row, column or diagonal wins.
game_tictactoe.tip1: 開く で the center: take the center then a diagonal to control the board.
game_tictactoe.tip2: Defend first: block immediately when the 相手 has two in a row.
game_tictactoe.tip3: Double threat: create two lines one move from winning so the 相手 can't block both.
game_tictactoe.ai_desc: 初級: random 手数. 普通: heuristic + blocks threats. 上級: minimax + perfect プレイ (で optimal プレイ the first player can always force a 引き分け).

game_gomoku.name: 五目並べ
game_gomoku.title: 五目並べ
game_gomoku.desc: 15×15 board. Connect five in a row to 勝利.
game_gomoku.rules: On a 15×15 board, black 手数 first. Players alternately place stones on intersections; the first to line up five stones horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins. No forbidden 手数.
game_gomoku.tip1: Double-three / 開く-four: create two 開く lines the 相手 can't block at once to boost your 勝利 rate.
game_gomoku.tip2: Defend first: block immediately when the 相手 has four in a row (unless you can form an even stronger threat).
game_gomoku.tip3: Control key ポイント: grab the center と star ポイント early to expand your territory.
game_gomoku.ai_desc: 初級: random + simple heuristics. 普通: scoring + shallow 検索. 上級: threat-space 検索 + locally optimal プレイ.

game_connect4.name: コネクトフォー
game_connect4.title: コネクトフォー
game_connect4.desc: 7×6 board で gravity. Connect four in a row to 勝利.
game_connect4.rules: 7 columns × 6 rows で gravity; red goes first. Click ↓ above a column to drop a piece (they stack). The first to connect four in a row, column or diagonal wins. Full columns can't be used.
game_connect4.tip1: 中央を制す：中央の列はあらゆる方向への脅威を最大にします。
game_connect4.tip2: ダブルスレットを作る：両方が一手で勝ちとなるラインを2つ作ります。
game_connect4.tip3: Defend the height: block above the 相手's develop-ing line before they 勝利.
game_connect4.ai_desc: 初級: random. 普通: immediate 勝利/block + window scoring. 上級: depth-limited negamax + heuristic ordering.

game_othello.name: オセロ
game_othello.title: オセロ
game_othello.desc: 8×8 flip game. Trap と flip your 相手's pieces.
game_othello.rules: 8×8 board, black goes first; four discs 開始 in the center. Place a disc to trap a line of 相手 discs horizontally, vertically or diagonally — すべて trapped discs flip to your color. Pass if you have no 手数. Most discs at the end wins.
game_othello.tip1: 角 > 辺 > 中央：角の駒は裏返されません — 安定。中央の駒は最も裏返されやすい。
game_othello.tip2: Avoid giving corners: don't force yourself into the square 次へ to a corner.
game_othello.tip3: 裏返す枚数は少ない方が良い：一度に多く裏返すと弱点を作る。上級者は量より安定を重視します。
game_othello.ai_desc: 初級: random. 普通: positional weights + flip balance. 上級: depth-limited negamax + mobility/frontier weights.

game_checkers.name: チェッカー
game_checkers.title: チェッカー
game_checkers.desc: Classic 8×8 draughts で forced captures, multi-jumps と kings. vs AI で 3 difficulties.
game_checkers.rules: 8×8 board, black 手数 first, pieces advance diagonally. Captures are forced; multi-jumps allowed; reaching the far ランキング crowns a king that may move backward. 敗北 by immobilization or no pieces.
game_checkers.tip1: 強制取り：取れる時は必ず取る — 連続ジャンプで一気に複数枚を取れるよう工夫します。
game_checkers.tip2: Crown kings early: kings move backward と become much stronger.
game_checkers.tip3: Control the center: center pieces have もっと room; first-mover has an edge.
game_checkers.ai_desc: 初級: random + simple heuristics. 普通: scoring + shallow 検索. 上級: deep 検索 + capture quiescence.
game_checkers.coach_desc: Click a piece to highlight すべて legal 手数; after each move, AI gives a bilingual ヒント to ヘルプ you understand the position.

chess.won_by_mate: がチェックメイトで勝利
chess.you_white: You プレイ White, move first
chess.you_black: You プレイ Black, waiting for White

chess.what_is_desc: チェス is the world's most 人気 strategy board game. It originated in 6th-century India as Chaturanga, traveled through Persia to Europe, と took its modern form there. Two players maneuver pieces on an 8×8 board to attack the 相手's king — checkmate wins. チェス is an Olympic sport と the first board game where AI surpassed the human world champion.
chess.piece_board_desc: An 8×8 board of alternating light と dark squares
chess.piece_king_desc: 手数 one square in any direction
chess.piece_queen_desc: The strongest piece — 手数 any number of squares in any direction
chess.piece_rook_desc: 手数 any number of squares horizontally or vertically
chess.piece_bishop_desc: 手数 any number of squares diagonally, staying on one color for life
chess.piece_knight_desc: 手数 in an L-shape — the only piece that can jump over others
chess.piece_pawn_desc: 手数 forward, captures diagonally; promotion と en passant apply
chess.feat1: Complete rules: castling, en passant と promotion すべて included
chess.feat2: AI 相手: 4 難易度 levels from beginner to advanced
chess.feat3: Real-時間 プレイ: friend matches + random matchmaking
chess.feat4: ヒント system: beginner friendly, click to 表示 legal 手数
chess.feat5: 棋譜：全手を再現して確認できます
chess.basic_strategy: 初心者向け 3つの基本戦略
chess.bs1_desc: The opening revolves around the four central squares d4, e4, d5 と e5. Controlling the center maximizes your pieces' range.
chess.bs2_desc: Bring out knights と bishops (minor pieces) before the queen と rooks (major pieces), getting もっと pieces into the fight.
chess.bs3_desc: キャスリングはキングを守りつつルークを起動します。早期にキャスリングしてキングを安全に。
chess.faq_login: Do I need an account to 保存 results?
chess.faq_login_a: No — it's optional. ログイン to 保存 your マッチ history と ランキング ポイント, or simply プレイ as a ゲスト.
chess.faq_diff: How do I choose the AI 難易度?
chess.faq_diff_a: Level 1 is for complete beginners. Levels 2–3 require basic strategy. Level 4 (上級) calculates several 手数 ahead.

tictactoe.invalid_name: Enter your ニックネーム
tictactoe.what_is_desc: 三目並べ is the world's simplest classic two-player game. On a 3×3 grid, two players alternate placing X と O; the first to connect three horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins. It's the perfect introduction to game theory — perfect プレイ from both sides always ends in a 引き分け.
tictactoe.rule1: 3×3 grid, X 手数 first, O second
tictactoe.rule2: 交互に空マスにマークを付ける。マークは動かない
tictactoe.rule3: 先に3つ並べた方が勝ち
tictactoe.rule4: Grid full で no winner is a 引き分け
tictactoe.hp1: Pick a mode: AI, friend or random マッチ
tictactoe.hp2: X 手数 first — click an empty square
tictactoe.hp3: O 手数 次へ (or the AI responds)
tictactoe.hp4: Block your 相手's threats while creating your own
tictactoe.hp5: 先に3つ並べた方が勝ち
tictactoe.strat1_desc: Opening in a corner raises your 勝利 rate — it guarantees at least a 引き分け. Opening in the center can 敗北 depending on O's reply.
tictactoe.strat2_title: 2. 相手の2個目をブロック
tictactoe.strat2_desc: The moment your 相手 places two marks on one line, block the third square immediately!
tictactoe.strat3_desc: Threaten two winning lines at once — your 相手 can block only one, と あなたの勝ち. This is 三目並べ's core tactic.
tictactoe.faq_win_a: で perfect プレイ from both sides the game is always a 引き分け. If X blunders, O can 勝利 — と vice versa.
tictactoe.faq_expand: より大きな盤面に拡張できますか？
tictactoe.faq_expand_a: はい! This site also has a 3×3 算数 version (Sum=15) plus 4×4 と 5×5 connection variants.

gomoku.invalid_name: Enter your ニックネーム
gomoku.what_is_desc: 五目並べ (Five in a Row) is a classic two-player strategy game 人気 across East Asia. Black と white alternate placing stones on a 15×15 board; the first to line up five horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins. The rules are simple but the strategy runs deep — a minute to learn, a lifetime to master.
gomoku.rule2: 石は交差点に置く。一度置いたら動かない
gomoku.rule3: 先に5つ並べた方が勝ち
gomoku.rule4: Optional forbidden 手数 (double-three, double-four, overline)
gomoku.play1: Pick a mode: AI, friend or random マッチ
gomoku.play2: Click an intersection to place a stone — black 手数 first
gomoku.play3: Watch your 相手 と read 2–3 手数 ahead
gomoku.play4: Create 開く threes と fours to force your 相手 to defend
gomoku.play5: 先に5つ石を並べた方が勝ち
gomoku.skill1_title: 1. Build 開く Threes と Fours
gomoku.skill1_desc: A four is a threat that must be blocked (or your 相手 wins 次へ move). An 開く three is one step from a four — mastering these shapes is 五目並べ's foundation.
gomoku.skill2_title: 2. ダブルスリー／ダブルフォー
gomoku.skill2_desc: Create two 開く threes (or fours) at once — your 相手 can only block one, locking in the 勝利.
gomoku.skill3_desc: 中央の価値が最も高い。一手ごとに「この石はどの方向に伸びられるか」を考えよう。
gomoku.faq_forbidden_a: To offset black's first-move advantage, black is restricted: no double-threes, double-fours or overlines (six or もっと), or black loses. This can be toggled in 設定.
gomoku.faq_diff: How do I choose the AI 難易度?
gomoku.faq_diff_a: 初級: random + simple heuristics for beginners. 普通: evaluation + shallow 検索. 中級: threat-space 検索. 上級: locally optimal 手数 for advanced players.
gomoku.faq_undo: Can I 元に戻す a move?
gomoku.faq_undo_a: はい — long-press the board or tap the 元に戻す button to take 戻る one move.

connect4.invalid_name: Enter your ニックネーム
connect4.what_is_desc: Connect Four is a classic two-player strategy game first sold by Milton Bradley in 1974. It's played on a vertical 7×6 board where pieces fall from the top と stack up. Players take turns dropping pieces; the first to connect four horizontally, vertically or diagonally wins. Simple on the surface, but solved by algorithms — research proved the first player has a winning strategy.
connect4.rule1: 7 columns × 6 rows, red 手数 first
connect4.rule2: 駒は自動的にその列の一番下に落ちる
connect4.rule3: 先に4つ並べた方が勝ち
connect4.rule4: Board full で no winner is a 引き分け
connect4.play1: Pick a mode: AI, friend or random マッチ
connect4.play2: 列の上の矢印をクリックして駒を落とす
connect4.play3: 駒はその列の一番下の空きマスに落ちる
connect4.play4: 横・縦・斜めのいずれかで4つ並べる
connect4.play5: Build your own line while blocking your 相手's
connect4.strat1_desc: The center column (column 4) participates in the most winning lines — controlling it is the key to the board. Research shows players who own over 70% of center cells almost always 勝利.
connect4.strat2_title: 2. ダブルスレットを作る
connect4.strat2_desc: Build two three-in-a-rows at once — your 相手 can only block one, locking in the 勝利.
connect4.strat3_desc: Drop pieces low to 退出 room for connections above. Fill the bottom rows first, then プレイ upward.
connect4.faq_draw: Can Connect Four end in a 引き分け?
connect4.faq_draw_a: In theory はい (the board fills で no winner), but it's extremely rare at higher levels — the first player usually wins.
connect4.faq_diff: How many AI 難易度 levels are there?
connect4.faq_diff_a: Three: 初級 (1–2 ply lookahead), 普通 (4–6 ply) と 上級 (7+ ply で an evaluation function).
connect4.faq_mobile_a: Fully. The responsive design adapts to phones と tablets — just tap a column to drop a piece.

othello.invalid_name: Enter your ニックネーム
othello.skip_you: You have no 手数 — pass
othello.skip_cpu: CPU has no 手数 — pass
othello.skip_opp: 相手 has no 手数 — pass
othello.what_is_desc: オセロ (リバーシ) is a deeply strategic two-player board game. It originated in 19th-century England と became a worldwide hit after being commercialized in Japan in 1971. Players alternate placing discs on an 8×8 board, flipping straight lines of 相手 discs. The one で もっと discs at the end wins — position matters もっと than count.
othello.rule1: 8×8 board で four discs in the center, two black と two white on diagonals
othello.rule2: A move must sandwich at least one 相手 disc in a straight line (horizontal, vertical or diagonal)
othello.rule3: すべて sandwiched 相手 discs flip to your color
othello.rule4: 合法手がなければパス。両者とも打てない時ゲーム終了
othello.rule5: Whoever has もっと discs at the end wins
othello.hp1: Black 手数 first automatically — click a highlighted legal square
othello.hp2: Your 新規 disc must sandwich at least one 相手 disc together で one of your own
othello.hp3: すべて sandwiched 相手 discs flip to your color automatically
othello.hp4: Look for the highlighted legal 手数 on the board
othello.hp5: If you have no legal move, your ターン passes automatically
othello.strat1_desc: 四隅は絶対に裏返されない — 永久に安全。可能な限り確保しよう。
othello.strat2_desc: 辺の駒は3方向のみ露出。中央より安全。辺を優先しよう。
othello.strat3_desc: Flip few discs early と secure good positions; 保存 mass flips for the endgame. First 20 手数: prioritize placement, not count.
othello.strat4_desc: 両側に自分の駒がある駒は裏返せない。安定した形を作ろう。
othello.faq_diff: オセロ vs Go — what's the difference?
othello.faq_diff_a: Completely different. Go is について claiming territory; オセロ flips your 相手's discs. オセロ has simple rules で deep strategy, while Go has minimal rules で endless depth.
othello.faq_no_moves: Why can I run out of legal 手数?
othello.faq_no_moves_a: If no move can sandwich an 相手 disc, you must pass. The game automatically shows Pass.

checkers.what_is_desc: チェッカー (Draughts) is one of the world's oldest board games, dating 戻る to ancient Egypt around 3000 BC. It is played only on the dark squares of an 8×8 board, で 12 pieces per side. Pieces move diagonally と capture by jumping over opponents. 勝利 by capturing すべて enemy pieces or leaving your 相手 で no 手数.

checkers.rule2: 通常駒は前方の斜めに1マス移動
checkers.rule3: Capture: jump over an adjacent 相手 piece into the empty square beyond
checkers.rule4: Multi-jump: complete すべて possible captures in one ターン
checkers.rule5: 強制取り：取れる時は必ず取る
checkers.rule6: Kinging: reach the far row to become a King that 手数 と captures backwards
checkers.strat1_desc: The central 4×4 area controls the most directions. Occupy it to limit your 相手's 手数.
checkers.strat2_desc: Before each move ask: if my piece gets taken, can I take 戻る? Don't give away pieces for nothing.
checkers.strat3_desc: Kings move in すべて directions と are far もっと flexible. Push pieces to the far row as early as possible.
